contentEn:
## Anti-Skateboard Devices for Canadian properties

**Anti-Skateboard Devices** are the most-specified anti-skateboarding hardware category for Canadian municipalities, transit authorities, schools, and commercial property owners. The primary search intent — anti skateboard — runs **110 searches per month** in Canada, concentrated among procurement officers and facility managers comparing climate-rated options across vendors.

## Why climate-rated matters

Off-the-shelf US-spec deterrent hardware fails Canadian winters: anchors heave at frost depths of 1.2–2.4 m, 304 stainless pits within 5–7 years on the BC and Atlantic coasts, and concrete-set epoxies cure inconsistently below -10°C. Every product on this page is engineered to **NBCC frost-depth tables**, **CSA-certified for outdoor public-realm installs**, and supplied with **316 marine-grade stainless** as the default for any city within 25 km of salt-water exposure.

## Our most-specified line for this application

For most anti skateboard requirements we recommend our [Skate Stoppers](/skate-stoppers). It is in active use across Canadian transit, school, and heritage-property procurement, with stamped engineering for every climate zone from Vancouver (Zone 4, low frost) to Yellowknife (Zone 8, 2.4 m frost). The full product line, including alternative finishes (brushed stainless, bronze patina, custom powder-coat), is on our [products catalogue](/products).

## Industries we deploy with most often

This category sees highest volume in [transit authorities](/transit-authorities) — where large public-realm exposure, multi-year procurement agreements, and bonded install crews are the norm. We hold active vendor agreements with **TTC, STM, OC Transpo, Calgary Transit, BC Transit**, and the parks departments of every major Canadian city. For city-specific climate engineering notes — snow load, frost depth, corrosion class — see our [coverage map](/cities).

## Procurement, install, and warranty

Standard procurement is **direct purchase under $50K** or **public RFP/DDP above $50K** through MERX (federal), provincial portals (BC Bid, AchatsEtVentes.gc.ca), and municipal procurement offices. We respond to RFPs within **5 business days** with stamped engineering, AODA / accessibility-code conformance letters, climate heatmaps for the destination city, and **bonded contractor accreditations** for prevailing-wage municipal work. Install crews carry **$5M general liability** and are insured to work on TTC, STM, GO, and Metrolinx properties. Warranty is **10 years on coatings, lifetime on 316L marine-grade structural elements**. For more on specifying for the Canadian winter, read our [climate-zone buying guide](/blog/specifying-skate-stoppers-canadian-winter).

## Get a quote

Tell us the city, surface type (ledge, bench, handrail, concrete edge), linear footage, and target install window. Most quotes return within 24 hours with stamped engineering attached. [Request a quote](/contact).

## Dispositifs anti-planche à roulettes pour les propriétés canadiennes

Le matériel dissuasif standard américain échoue dans les hivers canadiens : les ancrages se soulèvent aux profondeurs de gel de 1,2 à 2,4 m, l'inox 304 se pique en 5 à 7 ans sur les côtes BC et Atlantique, et les époxys ancrés au béton durcissent inégalement sous -10°C. Pour la plupart des besoins, nous recommandons notre [Skate Stoppers](/fr/bloque-skate). Elle est en service à travers les marchés publics canadiens du transit, des écoles et du patrimoine, avec ingénierie estampillée pour chaque zone climatique de Vancouver (Zone 4, faible gel) à Yellowknife (Zone 8, 2,4 m de gel). La gamme complète, incluant finitions alternatives (inox brossé, patine bronze, revêtement par poudre personnalisé), est sur notre [catalogue de produits](/fr/produits).

## Industries où nous déployons le plus

Cette catégorie voit le plus haut volume dans [transit authorities](/fr/autorites-transport) — où l'exposition publique étendue, les ententes d'approvisionnement pluriannuelles et les équipes d'installation cautionnées sont la norme. Nous détenons des ententes actives avec **TTC, STM, OC Transpo, Calgary Transit, BC Transit**, et les services de parcs de chaque grande ville canadienne. Pour les notes d'ingénierie climatique propres à chaque ville — charge de neige, profondeur de gel, classe de corrosion — consultez notre [carte de couverture](/fr/villes).

## Approvisionnement, installation et garantie

L'approvisionnement standard est **achat direct sous 50 K $** ou **DDP public au-delà** via MERX (fédéral), portails provinciaux (BC Bid, AchatsEtVentes.gc.ca), et bureaux d'approvisionnement municipaux. Nous répondons aux DDP dans **5 jours ouvrables** avec ingénierie estampillée, lettres de conformité LAPHO/accessibilité, cartes thermiques climatiques pour la ville de destination, et **accréditations d'entrepreneur cautionné** pour le travail municipal au taux prévalent. Les équipes d'installation ont une **responsabilité civile de 5 M $** et sont assurées pour travailler sur les propriétés TTC, STM, GO et Metrolinx. La garantie est de **10 ans sur les revêtements, à vie sur les éléments structurels en inox 316L grade marin**. Pour plus d'information sur la spécification pour l'hiver canadien, lisez notre [guide d'achat par zone climatique](/fr/blogue/specifier-bloque-skate-hiver-canadien).

contentEn:
## What skate stops do

**Skate stops** (also written *skate stop* or *stop skateboarding* hardware) are surface-mount, concrete-set, or continuous-edge fasteners that physically prevent skateboard, BMX, and inline-skate grinds on ledges, benches, handrails, and curb edges. The Canadian market searches for **'skate stop' (90/mo)**, **'skate stops' (90/mo)**, and **'stop skateboarding' (90/mo)** — three near-identical commercial-intent queries that all resolve to the same buyer: a procurement officer or property manager looking to retrofit deterrent hardware.

## Where skate stops are deployed

The highest-volume Canadian deployments are in [transit shelter benches](/transit-authorities), [school courtyards and library entrances](/schools-universities), and [municipal park furniture](/municipalities-parks). Heritage building owners specify bronze-patina skate stops for designated façades. Commercial property managers retrofit [granite ledges and planter walls](/commercial-real-estate) after the first vandalism event documents on insurance claims.

## Climate engineering for Canadian winters

Skate stops anchored with US-spec carbon steel fail Canadian winters: salt-air exposure pits 304 stainless within 5–7 years on the BC and Atlantic coasts, anchors heave at frost depths of 1.2–2.4 m, and concrete-set epoxies cure inconsistently below -10 °C. Every product on this site is engineered to **NBCC frost-depth tables** with **316L marine-grade stainless** as the default for any city within 25 km of salt-water exposure.

## Recommended product

For most retrofit applications we recommend [Skate Stoppers](/skate-stoppers): the highest-deterrent-effect surface-mount studs in our line, with stamped engineering for every Canadian climate zone. For continuous edges over 6 m, see [Skateboard Deterrents for Sidewalks](/skateboard-deterrents-for-sidewalks).

## Get a quote

Tell us the surface (ledge, bench, handrail, curb), linear footage, and target install city. Most quotes return within 24 hours with stamped engineering. [Request a quote](/contact).

## Procurement timing across Canada

Most Canadian municipal procurement cycles run on a **3-year capital plan**, with skate-deterrent installs scheduled in the spring/fall window between frost-thaw and freeze-up. We respond to RFPs within **5 business days** with stamped engineering for every climate zone — Vancouver (Zone 4, low frost) to Yellowknife (Zone 8, 2.4 m frost). Bonded crews carry $5M general liability and prevailing-wage municipal accreditation across Ontario, BC, Alberta, Quebec, and Maritimes provinces.

## Why climate-rated matters

Off-the-shelf US-spec deterrent hardware fails Canadian winters: 304 stainless pits within 5-7 years on BC and Atlantic coasts; anchors heave at frost depths of 1.2-2.4 m; concrete-set epoxies cure inconsistently below -10 °C. Every product on this page is engineered to **NBCC frost-depth tables** with **316L marine-grade stainless** as the default for any city within 25 km of salt-water exposure. Lifetime corrosion warranty on 316L; 25-year on 304.

descriptionEn: No-skateboarding signs alone don't stop skating. Compare signage to physical skate-stop hardware — installation cost, enforcement reality, and Canadian legal precedent.
descriptionFr: Les panneaux d'interdiction seuls n'arrêtent pas le skateboard. Comparez la signalisation au matériel anti-skate physique.
contentEn:
## Why signs alone don't work

The Canadian search term **'no skateboarding sign' (50/mo)** is one of the highest-volume queries in our category — but it's also the **lowest-effectiveness solution**. Property owners post **no-skateboarding signs** after a vandalism event, and ledges keep getting ground because skaters do not consult signage. The actionable answer is physical hardware.

## Cost comparison: signage vs. physical deterrents

A municipal-grade no-skateboarding sign costs **$80–$200 installed**. A 6-metre run of [Skate Stoppers](/skate-stoppers) costs **~$600 installed** and reduces grind events to zero. The signage approach also requires bylaw enforcement infrastructure (security patrols, fines) which most property owners cannot fund. Physical deterrents are **one-time capex** with **lifetime warranty** on 316L stainless components.

## Legal precedent in Canada

Canadian property owners are not relieved of liability by signage alone. Tort law in Ontario, BC, and Quebec treats a known-hazard ledge as a duty-of-care obligation regardless of posted signs. Physical deterrents discharge the duty of care; signage alone does not.

## Recommended approach

1. Install [Skate Stoppers](/skate-stoppers) on ledges and seating walls.
2. Add [Skateboard Deterrents for Handrails](/skateboard-deterrents-for-handrails) on stair and ramp rails.
3. Use **no-skateboarding signs** as a **secondary** awareness tool, not the primary intervention.

[Request a quote](/contact) for a property assessment.

## Frequently asked

**Are no-skateboarding signs legally required?** No federal or provincial Canadian statute requires them. Municipal bylaws vary. **Do no-skateboarding signs deter skating?** Modestly. Combined with physical hardware they reinforce duty-of-care documentation, but alone they have low effectiveness.

## Procurement timing across Canada

Most Canadian municipal procurement cycles run on a **3-year capital plan**, with skate-deterrent installs scheduled in the spring/fall window between frost-thaw and freeze-up. We respond to RFPs within **5 business days** with stamped engineering for every climate zone — Vancouver (Zone 4, low frost) to Yellowknife (Zone 8, 2.4 m frost). Bonded crews carry $5M general liability and prevailing-wage municipal accreditation across Ontario, BC, Alberta, Quebec, and Maritimes provinces.

## Why climate-rated matters

Off-the-shelf US-spec deterrent hardware fails Canadian winters: 304 stainless pits within 5-7 years on BC and Atlantic coasts; anchors heave at frost depths of 1.2-2.4 m; concrete-set epoxies cure inconsistently below -10 °C. Every product on this page is engineered to **NBCC frost-depth tables** with **316L marine-grade stainless** as the default for any city within 25 km of salt-water exposure. Lifetime corrosion warranty on 316L; 25-year on 304.

descriptionFr: Dissuasifs anti-planche à roulettes en inox 304 et 316L grade marin. Garantie corrosion à vie. Conçus pour chaque zone de gel canadienne.
contentEn:
## Stainless steel skateboard deterrents — grade matters

When Canadian property managers, transit authorities, and municipal procurement officers search for **stainless steel skateboard deterrents**, the question that decides the spec is **304 vs 316L**. Both are stainless. Only one survives a Canadian winter on the BC, Atlantic, or St. Lawrence coast. The wrong grade pits within **5–7 years** and gets condemned at the next infrastructure inspection — a costly re-spec the city pays for twice.

## 304 vs 316L marine-grade — the Canadian rule of thumb

**304 stainless** is the default North American architectural grade. It performs well on inland sites with low chloride exposure: Calgary, Edmonton, Saskatoon, Winnipeg, Regina, Sudbury. We supply 304 as standard for these climates and warranty it for **25 years against pitting**.

**316L marine-grade** adds 2–3% molybdenum to resist chloride attack from salt-water aerosols and road de-icing salt. It is **mandatory** for any site within **25 km of salt-water exposure** (Vancouver, Victoria, Halifax, St. John’s, Charlottetown, Saint John, Saguenay, Sept-Îles) and **strongly recommended** for Quebec / Ontario sites within **5 km of a major highway** that is salt-treated November–April. We carry **lifetime corrosion warranty** on 316L structural elements.

## Where stainless skateboard deterrents are specified

- **Transit authorities** — TTC, STM, OC Transpo, BC Transit, Calgary Transit — spec 316L on platform-edge benches and shelter handrails because road-salt aerosol is constant
- **Heritage properties** — Parks Canada, Heritage Toronto, Ville de Québec heritage districts — require **bronze patina or 316L brushed finish** for visual approval; 304 polished is rejected on heritage submissions
- **Coastal commercial real estate** — Vancouver, Halifax, St. John’s waterfront properties spec 316L by default in their RFPs
- **Schools and universities** — most spec 304 for cost (low chloride exposure on inland campuses) but UBC, Dalhousie, MUN spec 316L

## Finishes available in stainless

- **Polished 304 / 316L** — mirror finish, modern commercial, retail storefronts
- **Brushed 304 / 316L** — satin texture, hides fingerprints, default for transit and corporate campuses
- **Bead-blasted 316L** — matte texture, heritage-approval finish
- **Powder-coated over 316L core** — custom RAL color, used for branded retail (still 316L underneath for corrosion warranty)

## Procurement and lead times

304 stainless is **stocked in Toronto, Vancouver, and Montréal** for **5–7 business day lead times**. 316L marine-grade is **made-to-order** with **3–4 week lead times** — plan procurement accordingly for spring install windows. We respond to RFPs within **5 business days** with stamped engineering and the corrosion-class certificate for the destination city. [Request a quote](/contact) with your destination postal code and we’ll spec the correct grade.

## Related products

All our hardware lines ship in stainless: [Skate Stoppers](/skate-stoppers), [Skateboard Deterrents for Ledges](/skateboard-deterrents-for-ledges), [Handrail Skate Stoppers](/skateboard-deterrents-for-handrails), [Bench Skate Stoppers](/skateboard-deterrents-for-benches), [Concrete-Set Skate Deterrents](/skateboard-deterrents-for-concrete), and [Linear-Edge Sidewalk Strips](/skateboard-deterrents-for-sidewalks). For wall-mount and retaining-wall applications see [Skateboard Deterrents for Walls](/skateboard-deterrents-for-walls).

## Dissuasifs anti-planche à roulettes en inox — le grade compte

Lorsque les gestionnaires immobiliers, sociétés de transport et agents d'approvisionnement municipaux canadiens cherchent **dissuasifs anti-planche à roulettes en inox**, la question qui décide la spécification est **304 contre 316L**. Les deux sont en inox. Un seul survit à un hiver canadien sur les côtes de la C.-B., de l'Atlantique ou du Saint-Laurent. Le mauvais grade se pique en **5 à 7 ans** et est condamné à la prochaine inspection — une re-spécification coûteuse que la ville paie deux fois.

## 304 contre 316L grade marin — la règle canadienne

**L'inox 304** est le grade architectural nord-américain par défaut. Il fonctionne bien sur les sites intérieurs à faible exposition aux chlorures : Calgary, Edmonton, Saskatoon, Winnipeg, Regina, Sudbury. Nous le fournissons en standard pour ces climats avec **garantie de 25 ans contre la piqûre**.

**L'inox 316L grade marin** ajoute 2 à 3 % de molybdène pour résister aux chlorures des aérosols marins et du sel de déglace. Il est **obligatoire** pour tout site à moins de **25 km d'exposition à l'eau salée** (Vancouver, Victoria, Halifax, St. John's, Charlottetown, Saint John, Saguenay, Sept-Îles) et **fortement recommandé** pour les sites québécois et ontariens à moins de **5 km d'une autoroute majeure** salée de novembre à avril. Nous offrons une **garantie corrosion à vie** sur les éléments structurels en 316L.

## Où l'on spécifie les dissuasifs en inox

- **Sociétés de transport** — TTC, STM, OC Transpo, BC Transit — spécifient le 316L sur bancs de quai et mains courantes d'abribus
- **Propriétés patrimoniales** — Parcs Canada, Patrimoine Toronto, Ville de Québec — exigent **patine bronze ou inox 316L brossé** pour approbation visuelle
- **Immobilier commercial côtier** — Vancouver, Halifax, St. John's spécifient le 316L par défaut
- **Écoles et universités** — la plupart spécifient 304 pour le coût (faible exposition au chlorure)

## Finitions disponibles en inox

- **Poli 304 / 316L** — fini miroir, commerce moderne
- **Brossé 304 / 316L** — texture satin, masque les empreintes, défaut pour transit et campus
- **Sablé 316L** — texture mate, finition pour approbation patrimoniale
- **Revtu de poudre sur me 316L** — couleur RAL personnalisée

## Approvisionnement et délais

L'inox 304 est **stocké à Toronto, Vancouver et Montréal** avec délais de **5 à 7 jours ouvrables**. Le 316L grade marin est **fait sur commande** avec délais de **3 à 4 semaines**. Nous répondons aux DDP en **5 jours ouvrables** avec ingénierie estampillée et certificat de classe de corrosion pour la ville de destination. [Demander un devis](/fr/nous-joindre) avec votre code postal et nous spécifierons le bon grade.

## Produits associés

Toutes nos lignes sont disponibles en inox : [Bloque-skate](/fr/bloque-skate), [Dissuasifs pour rebords](/fr/dissuasifs-skateboard-pour-rebords), [Dissuasifs pour mains courantes](/fr/dissuasifs-skateboard-pour-mains-courantes), [Dissuasifs pour bancs](/fr/dissuasifs-skateboard-pour-bancs), [Dissuasifs pour béton](/fr/dissuasifs-skateboard-pour-beton) et [Bandes pour trottoirs](/fr/dissuasifs-skateboard-pour-trottoirs).
